name: Aniket Kumar
headline: Software engineer · Open-source contributor
bio: Aniket builds developer tooling, compiler and AST extensions, and applied machine learning systems. A long-time core contributor and mentor at HiPerHealth and a Google Summer of Code mentor, he contributes to projects including Rust-based parsers for VS Code extensions and AST implementations in astx. His work also spans published research in computer vision, biometric security, and ensemble predictive modeling, plus technical writing on LLM fine-tuning, JAX/Flax, and developer workflows.

name: Ivan Ogasawara
headline: Founder · Research software engineer
bio: Ivan is SciStitch’s founder and OSL’s founder and executive director. A research software engineer, he is the author of Makim and Sugar.

name: John Ever Vino Durán
headline: Full-stack software developer · Environmental engineer
bio: John is a full-stack software developer with over three years of experience building and deploying production systems with Python, Django, and JavaScript. His work spans data analysis, web scraping, and machine learning, including fine-tuning models for legal text classification. An environmental engineer with a background in bioprocess and mathematical modeling, he is also an active open-source mentor and project coordinator.

name: Luã Vacaro
headline: Full-stack developer · Data scientist
bio: Luã is a full-stack developer and data scientist with a focus on backend development, data analysis, and system administration. An open-source and open-science enthusiast, he joins SciStitch’s professional network as an independent collaborator.

name: Ricky Sambo Macharm
headline: Data scientist & AI/ML engineer
bio: Ricky brings experience in AI, data engineering, and international development across Africa and Europe. His work spans public health, data pipelines, and technical education. He contributes to Masakhane’s open-source research on African languages and holds a master’s degree in financial engineering.

name: Sai Sanjay Kottakota
headline: Software development engineer · Cloud-native open-source contributor
bio: Sai is a Software Development Engineer 1 at Murf AI and a cloud-native open-source contributor. He is an LFX 2026 mentee working on CNCF kube-burner, a GSoC 2025 contributor, and a GSoC 2026 mentor at Open Science Labs. His interests include performance engineering, Kubernetes systems, developer tooling, and Wayland-based remote desktop protocols.

name: Sandro Loch
headline: Web developer · Open-source contributor
bio: Sandro is a web developer and open-source contributor with experience in Python, Django, Docker, and Conda. He brings that background to SciStitch’s network as an independent collaborator.
